protocol.timing: Fresh actual constraint attempt per automatic request. On rejection, include handling, fresh beam1 MT if selected, and final retrieval in independent synchronized wall-clock total. No failed English is retrieved. 9-policy rotation,5rounds x16intents=80warm samples/policy,720/model. All failures included; first/scored requests excluded from warm stats. Trace serialization/digests after total.
protocol.failure_policy: Only current decoded constraint-output rejection triggers explicit fallback; OPUS fallback failure is terminal; Chinese fallback searches Chinese once; failed intents score zero.
protocol.first_request_note: Shared weights/process; first per decoder is not an independent cold start. No fallback first request is labeled cold. Startup validation/load separate.
protocol.reference_english_usage: Only Chinese goes to translators. Paired reference English never edits or replaces generated text.
protocol.independence: Same fixed16 queries and same40-image gallery already evaluated/diagnosed in terminology-constraints-v1. No new independent holdout; assistant-only labels, not human/field gold. No per-query routing/tuning or relabeling.
protocol.context_review: Earlier blinded assistant review applies to unchanged generated outputs; do not equate successful fallback with corrected wiring, mounting, negation or object ownership.
protocol.warm_evidence: Per-request semantic+ranking digest; full scored reference, with full ranking override for nonzero tolerated score drift.
protocol.fallback_chinese_fusion: Chinese alone once; requested fusion applies only when a valid English translation exists.
protocol.previous_reference_usage: After-run audit only, never consulted for routing or translation. Current control timings are freshly measured.
